assertion.en: Metals are good conductors of electricity.

reason.en: Metals have free (delocalized) electrons that can move through the metallic lattice and carry charge.

b.en: Both statements are true here - look again at whether the free electrons actually explain why metals conduct.

c.en: The Reason is true, not false - metals really do have free electrons that can move through the lattice.

d.en: The Assertion is true, not false - metals are in fact good conductors of electricity.

explanation.en: R correctly explains A: it's exactly the sea of free electrons in the metallic lattice, not bound to individual atoms, that carries charge - which is why metals conduct.

hints.en: Ask separately: is each statement true on its own, and only then whether the second explains the first.
